# Micah 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Woe to-me! For I-have-become like-gatherings-of summer-fruit, like-gleanings-of the-vintage; there-is-no cluster to-eat — no-early-fig my-soul desires.

**2** The-faithful-one has-perished from-the-earth, and-upright among-men there-is-none; all-of-them for-blood they-lie-in-wait; each his-brother they-hunt [with] a-net.

**3** Upon evil [are] both-hands to-do-[it]-well: the-prince asks, and-the-judge [is ready]-for-the-reward, and-the-great-one speaks the-desire-of his-soul, and-they-weave-it-together.

**4** The-best-of-them [is] like-a-brier; the-most-upright worse-than-a-thorn-hedge. The-day-of your-watchmen — your-punishment — has-come; now will-be their-confusion.

**5** Do-not-trust in-a-neighbor; do-not-rely on-a-friend; from-her-who-lies in-your-bosom guard the-doors-of your-mouth.

**6** For a-son dishonors [his]-father; a-daughter rises-up against her-mother; a-daughter-in-law against her-mother-in-law; a-man's-enemies [are] the-men-of his-[own]-house.

**7** But-I — in-YHWH I-will-watch; I-will-wait for-the-God-of my-salvation; my-God will-hear-me.

**8** Do-not-rejoice against-me, my-enemy! Though I-have-fallen, I-will-arise; though I-sit in-darkness, YHWH [is] a-light for-me.

**9** The-wrath-of YHWH I-will-bear, for I-sinned against-Him, until He-pleads my-case and-executes judgment for-me. He-will-bring-me-out to-the-light; I-will-see His-righteousness.

**10** And-my-enemy will-see, and-shame will-cover-her — she-who-said to-me, "Where [is] YHWH your-God?" My-eyes will-see-her; now she-will-be for-trampling like-mud-of [the]-streets.

**11** A-day for-building your-walls! That day — far will-be [the]-boundary.

**12** That day — to-you he-will-come, from-Assyria and-[the]-cities-of Egypt, and-from-Egypt to-the-River, and-sea from-sea and-mountain to-mountain.

**13** And-the-earth will-be a-desolation because-of her-inhabitants, from-the-fruit-of their-deeds.

**14** Shepherd Your-people with-Your-staff, the-flock-of Your-inheritance, dwelling alone in-a-forest in-the-midst-of Carmel; let-them-graze in-Bashan and-Gilead as-in-[the]-days-of old.

**15** "As-in-the-days-of your-going-out from-the-land-of Egypt, I-will-show-him wonders."

**16** Nations will-see and-be-ashamed of-all their-might; they-will-put hand upon mouth; their-ears will-be-deaf.

**17** They-will-lick dust like-the-serpent, like-crawling-things-of the-earth; they-will-come-trembling from-their-strongholds to-YHWH our-God — and-they-will-be-afraid of-You.

**18** Who [is] a-God like-You, bearing iniquity and-passing-over transgression for-the-remnant-of His-inheritance? He-does-not-retain His-anger forever, for delighting-in-mercy He [is].

**19** He-will-again have-compassion-on-us; He-will-tread-down our-iniquities; and-You-will-cast into-the-depths-of the-sea all their-sins.

**20** You-will-give truth to-Jacob, mercy to-Abraham, which You-swore to-our-fathers from-days-of old.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **7:6**: Oyvei ish anshei veito — 'a man's enemies are the men of his household.' Quoted by Jesus in Matthew 10:36. Societal breakdown reaches its nadir when the family itself disintegrates.

- **7:18**: Mi El kamokha — 'Who is a God like You?' A wordplay on Micah's own name (Mi-ka-yah = 'Who is like YHWH?'). The book ends with the prophet's name becoming the theology — the incomparability of God who forgives.

- **7:19**: Ve-tashlikh bi-metzulot yam kol-chatotam — 'You will cast into the depths of the sea all their sins.' The tashlich imagery — sins drowned beyond recovery. This verse gives its name to the Jewish Rosh Hashanah ceremony of symbolically casting sins into water.

— EMET
